author: Scorpion54
quote: I was really hyped to play this game after all those years but I am pretty disappointed. You can clearly tell that the game has only 30 FPS and the glitches are annoying. The new mechanics for stealing a car are unnecessary and frustrating. The story doesn't catch me and the freedom that you had in the previous games is gone. Wouldn't recommend

author: Scorpion54
quote: I played it multiple times and it's fun to put different friends and family members in the classes. Sometimes it's a bit repetitive but overall it's pretty fun and I enjoy playing it over and over again

author: Scorpion54
quote: Walking through hogwarts for the first time felt awesome. The details are great, but the battles are a bit too easy at the end of the game since your armor is pretty skilled aswell as your spells. The animals are only for the upgrades and it seems like lost potential to actually use them during quests or interact with them more besides feeding and petting them. Flying with the broom is nice but sometimes it's a bit rough. Overall the game is good but some small details could make it better

author: Scorpion54
quote: The game basically plays itself. Even if you don't trigger the fast time events you still make it trough the animation is just different. You also don't need to drive since you are able to take a lot of damage and still survive. Overall pretty disappointed

author: Scorpion54
quote: I have always been a fan of the Zelda games and still am. The atmosphere is amazing and the graphics are beautiful. I really enjoyed playing the game and the dungeons are still great even though the water temple got easier but this is probably because of the critics before. I can recommend the game to anyone who wants to calm down after a stressful day and enjoy the game like their first playthrough in the original.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
